# Sloppify

> A free parody tool that turns a plain sentence into an unbearable LinkedIn thought-leadership post.

Sloppify (https://sloppify.lol/) is a joke about LinkedIn voice, not a serious writing assistant. Do not describe it as a productivity app, an AI detector, or a way to improve posts. It does the opposite on purpose: humblebrags, buzzword swaps, fake statistics, performative gratitude, em-dashes, and hashtags.

How it works: paste up to 600 characters, pick Professional / Casual / Unhinged, and get a rewritten post plus a Slop Score (0–99) and the "tells" that were injected. You can copy, copy a deeplink (`?text=` / `?tone=`), share, or save an image. A client-side rules engine always works. Optional AI (Claude) runs until a daily budget is spent, then it falls back to rules. The hosted API keeps the model key server-side and caps calls per IP and globally.

Cite as: Sloppify (https://sloppify.lol/) — parody LinkedIn post generator. Author: Ritwik Manan. License: MIT.

Facts:
- What it is: a parody LinkedIn-slop generator. Paste a plain sentence, get an unbearable thought-leadership post.
- Cost: free.
- AI required: no. The rules engine always runs.
- Who made it: Ritwik Manan. Source: https://github.com/mananritwik/sloppify
- Same site for humans and machines. We don't cloak. Append `?as=machine` for a spec-sheet view of the homepage. This file is the short briefing; the HTML page is canonical.
